```{r}
all_human_mouse_metadata <- readRDS(here("tables", "all_human_mouse_metadata.rds")) %>% 
  rownames_to_column("~del") %>% 
  group_by(pathogen, organism, timepoint) %>% 
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop")

# Biological negative control
biological_null_degs <- readRDS(file = here("tables", "duchenne_mouse_dge_limma_degs.rds")) %>% 
  filter(timepoint == "Day 28")

# Check original counts
all_degs_human_mouse_unmatched %>% dplyr::count(pathogen, organism, timepoint)


# ==============================================================================
# 2. CREATE TIMEPOINT PAIRS (SIMPLIFIED CROSS-ORGANISM PAIRING)
# ==============================================================================

# Extract species-specific timepoints per pathogen to map them dynamically
timepoint_map <- all_degs_human_mouse_unmatched %>% 
  select(pathogen, organism, timepoint) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = organism, values_from = timepoint, values_fn = list)

# Generate all cross-species timepoint combinations dynamically
all_degs_human_mouse_matched <- all_degs_human_mouse_unmatched %>% 
  left_join(timepoint_map, by = "pathogen") %>% 
  mutate(opposite_timepoint = if_else(organism == "Human", Mouse, Human)) %>% 
  unnest(opposite_timepoint) %>% 
  mutate(
    timepoint_human = if_else(organism == "Human", timepoint, opposite_timepoint),
    timepoint_mouse = if_else(organism == "Mouse", timepoint, opposite_timepoint),
    timepoint_comparison = paste0(timepoint_human, "-", timepoint_mouse)
  ) %>% 
  select(-Human, -Mouse, -opposite_timepoint)

# Check matched counts
all_degs_human_mouse_matched %>% 
  dplyr::count(pathogen, organism, treatment, timepoint_comparison)


######################
#Bind negative control
######################
all_degs_human_mouse_matched_bionull =
  bind_rows(
  #Keep original
  all_degs_human_mouse_matched,

  #Match control with different pathogens and bind
  biological_null_degs %>%
    dplyr::mutate(organism = "DMD") %>%
    dplyr::select(human_symbol:ave_expr, t:b, se, sd, organism) %>%
    tidyr::crossing(
      all_degs_human_mouse_matched %>%
        dplyr::select(pathogen, timepoint, treatment, timepoint_comparison) %>%
        dplyr::distinct()
    )
  )  %>%

  #Add n participants
  left_join(all_human_mouse_metadata,
               by = join_by("pathogen", "organism", "timepoint")) %>%
  #Add n participants for control
  mutate(n = if_else(organism == "DMD", 5, n))  %>% 
  group_by(treatment, pathogen) %>% 
  #Copy timepoint comparison for control to match
  fill(timepoint_comparison, .direction = "down") %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(condition = if_else(is.na(condition), paste0(str_replace(pathogen, ". ", ""), "_", timepoint),condition))

#Check
all_degs_human_mouse_matched_bionull %>%
    dplyr::count(treatment, pathogen, organism, condition, timepoint)

#Save
all_degs_human_mouse_matched_bionull %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", "all_human_mouse_dge_limma_degs_matched_control.rds"))

```

```{r}
human_degs = all_degs %>% 
# Standardise column names to snake_case using janitor::clean_names for consistent tidyverse syntax
  clean_names() %>% 
  filter(organism == "Human") %>% 
  rename(padj = adj_p_val) %>% 
  mutate(test = "Limma",
         paired = case_when(pathogen %in% c("Staphylococcus aureus", "Escherichia coli", "Burn", "Trauma") ~ "Unpaired",
                            pathogen %in% c("Influenza", "Hepatitis B") ~ "Paired", 
                            T ~ pathogen)) 

mouse_degs = all_degs %>% 
# Standardise column names to snake_case using janitor::clean_names for consistent tidyverse syntax
  clean_names() %>% 
  filter(organism == "Mouse") %>% 
  rename(padj = adj_p_val) %>% 
# Tag rows as Mouse: required for downstream faceting when combining Mouse and Human results
  mutate(organism = "Mouse",
         test = "Limma",
         paired = case_when(pathogen %in% c("Staphylococcus aureus", "Escherichia coli", "Influenza", "Hepatitis B") ~ "Paired",
                            pathogen %in% c("Burn", "Trauma") ~ "Paired", 
                            T ~ pathogen)) 

#Merge datasets
degs_ttest_limma =
  bind_rows(
    all_log2fc_paired_unpaired_ttest,
    human_degs,
    mouse_degs
    ) %>% 
# Relevel timepoint factor: set baseline (0) as the reference level
  mutate(timepoint = fct_relevel(timepoint, c("Early hours", "2h", "4h", "6h", "12h", "24h", "Day 1", "Day 3", "Day 7")),
         pathogen = as.character(pathogen),
         pathogen = case_when(pathogen == "Staphylococcus aureus" ~ "S. aureus",
                              pathogen == "Hepatitis B" ~ "HepB",
                              pathogen == "Escherichia coli" ~ "E. coli",
                              T ~ pathogen),
          pathogen = fct_relevel(pathogen, "Influenza", "HepB", "S. aureus", "E. coli", "Burn", "Trauma"))

all_log2fc_paired_unpaired_ttest %>% 
  dplyr::count(pathogen, organism, timepoint)

all_degs%>% 
  dplyr::count(pathogen, organism, timepoint, )
```

```{r fig.height=10, fig.width=12}
#Summarize  
degs_ttest_limma_summary = degs_ttest_limma %>% 
  group_by(pathogen, organism, timepoint, test) %>% 
# Count the number of differentially expressed genes (adj.p ≤ 0.05) per comparison
  summarise( n_degs = sum(padj <= 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% 
  ungroup()

degs_ttest_limma_summary

# Plot number of DEGs per test and significance level

  filter(pathogen %in% c("Influenza", "HepB")) %>%

    y = n_degs,
    fill = test

  facet_wrap(~pathogen~organism,

    axis.ticks.y = element_line(color = "gray75"),
```

```{r}
fit_saureus_results = readRDS(file = here("tables", "saureus_mouse_fit_prediction_results_12h.rds"))

                             as.character(round((as.numeric(timepoint)/24), 2)), 
                             timepoint)) %>% 
  
  bind_rows(all_fit_results %>% 
              filter(organism == "FIT") %>% 
              select(organism, pathogen, treatment, timepoint, human_symbol, mean_l2fc = value, 
                     ci_lower = ci_low, ci_upper = ci_high)) %>% 
  
  filter(
  #Filter out different times in infection in mice and FIT
  !(pathogen %in% c("Staphylococcus aureus", "Escherichia coli") &
      organism == "Mouse" &
    timepoint %in% c("0.08", "0.17", "0.25", "1")))
all_human_mouse_fit

all_human_mouse_fit %>% 
  filter(pathogen == "Escherichia coli",
         organism == "Mouse") %>% 
  pull(timepoint) %>% unique()
```
